## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage5 top keeper attempts to improve edge capture on J's bearish reversal days by adjusting TP, stop, time stop, strike offset, chandelier arm, and vol ratio threshold. The hypothesis is that tighter premium stops and longer time stops allow capturing more of the ribbon ride while limiting losses on choppy days.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains the shotgun scalper's multi-condition trigger (volume surge, VIX threshold, EMA alignment). Exit uses premium-based TP at +75% of entry premium, stop at -35%, time stop at 12 minutes, strike offset 2 (OTM-2), chandelier profit-lock arms at 60% favor, and vol ratio threshold 1.2 to filter low-volume breakouts.
